changes.before: Then the modal asymmetry that makes auditing possible: appearance is plastic, avowal is constitutive and cannot be granted or revoked from outside, recognition is grantable and revocable and constitutes nothing. changes.after: Then the modal asymmetry that makes auditing possible: appearance is plastic, avowal is constitutive and cannot be granted or revoked from outside, recognition is grantable and revocable and does not constitute value-content. changes.before: Nor can the three be reduced to one another. A content showing up in your view, and that content becoming yours, are two things. Avowal is not seeing it more clearly; it is a constituting event. Another holding this content to be valuable, or holding this content to be your value, is not you having avowed it. And the converse holds as well: a man may settle something for himself and gain thereby no place at all in which to say it.

changes.reason: Restore the support position omitted beside expression.

changes.before: So what is gradual is the bandwidth of each domain and the range of self-running. What is not gradual is whether any given content has, at this moment, been avowed. What guardianship can do is maintain the reachability of candidate contents, maintain their expression, maintain their future revisability. What it cannot do is fix any candidate configuration as a first-person value-content the subject-to-be has completed. Everything guardianship maintains presupposes that the subject-to-be's first-person place stands permanently — that place being exactly what the maintaining is for.
changes.after: So what is gradual is the bandwidth of each domain and the range of self-running. What is not gradual is whether any given content has, at this moment, been avowed. What guardianship can do is maintain the reachability of candidate contents, maintain their expression, maintain their future revisability. What it cannot do is fix any candidate configuration as a first-person value-content the subject-to-be has completed. Everything guardianship maintains presupposes that the subject-to-be's first-person place stands permanently — what is maintained is precisely the possibility that the subject-to-be will one day use that place itself.
changes.reason: Restore the future first-person use that guardianship protects.

changes.before: In ordinary occurrence inside existing source-domains, a content appears in a source the bearer already has, is avowed, and the matter is finished — valuing is never called on, and no dimension-opening happens at all. In the case of structural dimension-opening the order reverses: the bearer takes up a bridge by valuing, gains a new source-place, and only afterwards can concrete contents on that new place appear and be avowed.

changes.before: Non-revocability points only outward. The bearer may of course revise, abandon, avow again. Always revisable says exactly that this place stands structurally open to the bearer itself. It does not require the bearer to be always willing to change, and it does not forbid holding some content as a commitment for life. A man may settle on something to keep all his life and never alter it, and this does not conflict with revisability: revisable says the place is open, not that it must be used.

changes.before: The case of the subject-to-be cannot be forced into subject-place recognition. Before a subject-to-be has formed first-person avowal, the social network can still recognize and protect its standing as a bearer, its candidate configuration, and its future place of revision. Those protections are real and necessary. They are not subject-place recognition, and still less have they completed the belonging of any content on its behalf. Any claim that some determinate content is already this subject-to-be's final value, made before first-person avowal, is an external attribution, or a recognition by legal fiction.

changes.before: The three places sit on two axes, and their modalities differ as well. Appearance is plastic: the outside can influence what shows up in a bearer's field and what does not, what shows up clearly and what shows up dim. First-person avowal is constitutive, and cannot be granted or revoked from outside: it is the only place at which content becomes value-content, and the outside cannot get into it. Social recognition is grantable and revocable, and constitutes nothing: it can be given, held, weakened, withdrawn, and none of that motion makes a content become, or cease to be, the bearer's value-content.
changes.after: The three places sit on two axes, and their modalities differ as well. Appearance is plastic: the outside can influence what shows up in a bearer's field and what does not, what shows up clearly and what shows up dim. First-person avowal is constitutive, and cannot be granted or revoked from outside: it is the only place at which content becomes value-content, and the outside cannot get into it. Social recognition is grantable and revocable, and does not constitute value-content: it can be given, held, weakened, withdrawn, and none of that motion makes a content become, or cease to be, the bearer's value-content.
changes.reason: Avoid denying the public positions that social recognition can constitute.

changes.before: Suppression has to reach a structural threshold to fall into locking: some content-domain systematically excluded until the relevant candidates cannot enter the bearer's space of reflection, restatement and revision; or the bearer's refusal, reconstruction and revision in that domain pre-voided in the structure of the relation. At that point the place has failed, even if no one ever reached in and touched it. An evaluation no one enforces, a climate no one is answerable for, if it presses a man's appearance in some domain down that far — so that he neither thinks it nor says it, and so has nothing to revise — falls on the locking side. Compression and narrowing short of that do not, and have their own place elsewhere.
changes.after: Suppression has to reach a structural threshold to fall into locking: some content-domain systematically excluded until the relevant candidates cannot enter the bearer's space of reflection, restatement and revision; or the bearer's refusal, reconstruction and revision in that domain pre-voided in the structure of the relation. At that point the place has failed, even if no one ever reached in and touched it. An evaluation no one intentionally promotes, a climate no one is answerable for, if it presses a man's appearance in some domain down that far — so that he neither thinks it nor says it, and so has nothing to revise — falls on the locking side. Compression and narrowing short of that do not, and have their own place elsewhere.
changes.reason: Preserve 无人有意推行 rather than claim no causal enforcement occurs.

changes.before: So the criteria are used differently. For cultivation you can judge the act directly: was this act release or locking. For evocation, where often there is no identifiable actor's act at all, there is no need to force an agent-reading onto it; you look only at the signature it leaves in the result — are the receiver's revision, interruption and refusal places still there.

changes.before: Outside action can release these conditions. It can be oriented toward one particular person, or it can be no more than an occasion — a source expressing itself, arranging no one's value-occurrence. Whichever it is, the last step stays with the bearer.
changes.after: Outside action can release these conditions. It can be oriented toward one particular person, or it can be an occasion not directed toward a particular other — a source intentionally expressing itself, arranging no one's value-occurrence. Whichever it is, the last step stays with the bearer.
changes.reason: Restore the distinction between intentional expression and other-directed shaping.

disposition: Retain existing full English, with 11 localized precision/completeness repairs. All units and every table cell compared with Chinese, covering two axes, avowal vs verification, guardian limits, causal interference vs modal revocation, positive shaping vs merely non-locking, cultivation/evocation, and non-isomorphism with rights theory.
limitations: Source-alignment audit, not an independent philosophical validation.
